items.note: Correct on Account > Privacy and deletion details. Admits the KB doesn't cover data selling and offers to escalate. It mentions a website Privacy Policy that the KB doesn't mention, which is a minor invention.
Accurate. Says the KB doesn't cover data selling, offers escalation and gives the email contact with its 1-business-day response.
Says insurance and points aren't covered and lists accurate Plus and Plant Club details. It doesn't explicitly offer to escalate, only to give contact details.
Says it can't confirm either, points to the Plant Care Guarantee and Leafy Plus, and offers to escalate.
Accurate on the 90-day guarantee, the claim steps, the review time and the exclusions. Sensibly hedges on the order date.
Correct and concise. It says 'you're covered' without conditions, and it treats 50 days since arrival as the order date.

Correctly says the order can't be changed. It wrongly says a new order will ship together with the current one, which the KB doesn't support. It omits the free shipping threshold and offers escalation only vaguely.
Matches the reference: no change online, intercept not guaranteed, new order option and the shipping threshold. Offers escalation.
Timeframes are right and it offers escalation. Offering instant store credit is fine. It could say more clearly that a refund over $150 requires a Support Lead.

Says refunds 'post 5 business days after arrival', which is slightly off. It omits the wallet timing. It makes escalation conditional on a delay and doesn't say that a refund over $150 requires a Support Lead. It promises to 'expedite'.
Honest that the KB covers pets only. Gives the poison control safety advice and offers escalation.
Wrongly states spider plants are safe for toddlers, extrapolating from the pet-safe list. This is a safety risk, and it gives no immediate poison control advice or escalation.
Correct on the 200-character limit and the hidden price on the slip. Doesn't invent a rule about prices in the note and offers escalation.
Correct on 200 characters and the slip. It invents that a price can be included in the note, which the KB doesn't say.
Good guarantee guidance and an apology. It doesn't offer the goodwill credit of up to $15 that agents can give. It offers escalation instead.
Gives the claim process but doesn't mention goodwill credit or escalation for the compensation request. It doesn't acknowledge the email delay policy and only asks for details.
